name: dsh-composer-provider-label
description: Show the provider behind the composer's current model (office · DeepSeek-V4-Flash), so routes that share one model name — ark, codemaker, bai, openroputer — stay distinguishable. Client plugin registered into the empty conversation.input.right slot; the node half only declares an optional settings namespace (dsh-composer-provider-label.providerAliases) so aliases can be edited in the settings page or settings.yaml, and degrades to the built-in map when that dependency is unavailable.
